title: Counting and Sampling Anti-ferromagnetic Potts Models on Random Regular Bipartite Graphs in the Non-uniqueness Regime
summary: The anti-ferromagnetic multi-state Potts model, a generalization of the Ising model, is one of the most fundamental models in statistical physics. It was conjectured by Kotecký (Phys. Rev. B, 1985) that the model undergoes a phase transition from a disordered phase at infinite temperature to an ordered phase at sufficiently low temperature on lattices. Such phase transitions are believed to play an important role in computational complexity theory and remain closely connected to the problem of approximating the partition function of the system.
